evidence.data-authz: N/A in this SPA diff: no table, policy or query. Admin pages (Auth/Dashboard) are unrouted (src/App.tsx); App.routes.test.tsx goes red if /auth is re-added. Real authz must live in the backend.
evidence.privileged-credential: openai dependency and VITE_OPENAI key path removed; browser calls only POST /api/chat. Smoke scans dist JS for sk-* keys and dangerouslyAllowBrowser; grep of dist/assets for VITE_OPENAI|api.openai.com|sk-proj|supabase finds nothing.
evidence.boundary-validation: Client caps match the backend contract (contact field maxLengths, chat message 1000, history <=10 x 2000, roles user|assistant only) - convenience only; server validation is authoritative. Contact success requires ok + JSON + success===true (tests incl. HTML-200 case).
evidence.secrets-pii: .gitignore covers .env* (except .env.example); chatbot debug log no longer prints the user message; server error text shown only if <=200 chars and rendered as React text; no stack traces surfaced.
evidence.webhooks: N/A: no webhook receiver in a static SPA.
evidence.storage: N/A: no file upload or storage access.
evidence.headers-csp: public/_headers adds HSTS, XFO DENY, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and a Report-Only CSP (connect-src self + *.sarayatechsolutions.com, no AI provider, script-src self, no unsafe-eval); tests/headers.test.mjs pins it; dist ships _headers.
evidence.ai-context: Prompt, model, key and token caps are server-side; client sends only message + capped history. AI reply rendered by react-markdown without rehype-raw (raw-HTML test) and with default urlTransform (javascript:/data:/vbscript: test added, mutation-checked); internal navigation only for hrefs passing isInternalHref (rejects // and /\); privacy notice above the input.
evidence.owasp-top-10: No injection sink (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML/eval in changed files); open redirect mitigated by isInternalHref; vite dev server bound to localhost by default; vulnerable deps reduced 26 -> 10 with non-major fixes, residual listed below.

findings.summary: vite <=6.4.3 / esbuild <=0.24.2 advisories (dev-server path traversal, fs.deny bypass on Windows, launch-editor issues, cross-origin requests to the dev server). Dev/build-time only; not in the deployed static bundle; exposure reduced by the dev server defaulting to localhost (vite.config.ts).
findings.fix: Dedicated dependency-upgrade issue: vite to a patched major (>=6.4.4 or 8.x) with plugin-react-swc, re-run build + verify.

findings.summary: vitest 3.2.7 / tinypool / @vitest/mocker advisories (critical prototype-pollution RCE gadget in tinypool worker options, mocker path traversal). Test-runner only, never shipped, not reachable by a site visitor.
findings.fix: Upgrade vitest to >=4.1.12 (semver-major) in the same dependency-upgrade issue.

findings.summary: react-router-dom 6.30.6: open redirect via backslash in <Link>/useNavigate and SSR deserializeErrors advisories (fix only in 7.18+). SSR not used; the only dynamic navigate() (src/components/chatbot/MarkdownRenderer.tsx:32) is guarded by isInternalHref which rejects '/\' and '//' (links.test.ts).
findings.fix: Keep the isInternalHref guard; plan react-router 7 migration as its own issue.

findings.summary: CSP is Report-Only and style-src allows 'unsafe-inline' (needed by runtime-injected component styles), so it does not yet block anything.
findings.fix: Observe reports on staging, then promote to Content-Security-Policy; revisit 'unsafe-inline' for styles once injected styles are inventoried.

findings.summary: No threat model covers the public site, contact form or AI chat boundary.
findings.fix: Run /threat-model for the contact + chat backend boundary (abuse, prompt injection, cost) before the backend goes live.
